sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, in FIR No.342 of 2019 on the file of Station Officer, Kothapet Police-Station, Guntur Urban.
The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 353, 273, 328, 420 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.3205 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.342 of 2019, on the file of Station Officer, Kothapet Police-Station, Guntur Urban for the offences under Sections 188, 353, 273, 328,
420 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.

D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 11.11.2019 GR Abburi Venu Gopal Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84108040/
